alarms.title: Main Vessel High Temperature
alarms.operator_response: Stop heating immediately, check thermal jacket circulation, and notify supervisor.

alarms.title: Vacuum Chamber Differential Pressure Loss
alarms.operator_response: Verify lid seal integrity, vacuum pump line valves, and cover lock switch.

alarms.title: Homogenizer High Shear Overspeed Warning
alarms.operator_response: Reduce homogenizer setpoint, verify product viscosity, and inspect VFD drive feedback.

alarms.title: Mechanical Seal Barrier Low Pressure Warning
alarms.operator_response: Inspect buffer fluid level and recharge nitrogen pressure.

alarms.title: Vessel Cover Safety Interlock Disengaged
alarms.operator_response: Lock vessel dome clamps before initiating agitation, heating, or vacuum sequence.

alarms.title: Delta PLC Communication Timeout / Link Degraded
alarms.operator_response: Verify Ethernet/IP Modbus/OPC UA physical connection to Delta AS332T-A PLC.
